rules.proposed_specification: An invoice requires both an existing purchase order and a receipt record before automatic payment occurs.
rules.source_text: An invoice requires both an existing purchase order and a receipt record before automatic payment.

rules.proposed_specification: An invoice variance of exactly EUR 10 is within tolerance.
rules.source_text: An invoice variance of exactly EUR 10 is within tolerance.

rules.proposed_specification: An invoice variance above EUR 10 blocks automatic payment.
rules.source_text: An invoice variance above EUR 10 blocks automatic payment.

rules.proposed_specification: For a blocked invoice, an Accounts Payable analyst is permitted to ask for a corrected invoice, but is not obliged to ask.
rules.source_text: For a blocked invoice, an Accounts Payable analyst may ask for a corrected invoice but is not obliged to ask.

rules.proposed_specification: Only the receiving team may record goods receipt, and Accounts Payable cannot record goods receipt.
rules.source_text: Only the receiving team records goods receipt; Accounts Payable cannot record goods receipt.

rules.proposed_specification: The person who changed supplier bank details must not approve payment to those details.
rules.source_text: The person who changed supplier bank details must not approve payment to those details.

rules.proposed_specification: For a service invoice, an authorised service acceptance replaces the goods receipt record.
rules.source_text: For a service invoice, an authorised service acceptance replaces the goods receipt record.

rules.proposed_specification: Service acceptance does not replace the purchase-order requirement.
rules.source_text: Service acceptance does not replace the purchase-order requirement.

rules.proposed_specification: A dispute freezes the payment clock until the dispute is resolved.
rules.source_text: A dispute freezes the payment clock until the dispute is resolved.

rules.proposed_specification: After dispute resolution, the payment clock resumes from its paused value rather than restarting at zero.
rules.source_text: After dispute resolution, the payment clock resumes from its paused value rather than restarting at zero.

rules.proposed_specification: An invoice number is unique only within a supplier, and different suppliers may reuse the same invoice number.
rules.source_text: An invoice number is unique only within a supplier; different suppliers may reuse the same number.

rules.proposed_specification: The tolerance is assessed per invoice, and not against the monthly sum of a supplier's invoices.
rules.source_text: The tolerance is assessed per invoice, not against the monthly sum of a supplier invoices.
